evidence_class: mocked: the legacy Redis previews and vector rows are fixture data shaped like the retired transcript service's store and embedding code, and a JSON file stands in for the authoritative audit record; no legacy Redis, Postgres or service was read

fixture_inputs.capped_redis_preview: beta, a legacy Redis entry preview with one entry at the 500 character cap
fixture_inputs.complete_jsonl: alpha, a surviving raw transcript with its legacy preview and vector rows
fixture_inputs.missing_source: delta, a session the legacy index named with no surviving material
fixture_inputs.vector_only_record: gamma, legacy vector rows with no raw transcript and no preview

interfaces: hooks.memory.source_audit.audit_source classifies one legacy session as full_raw, preview_only, vector_only or missing with import confidence lossless, lossy, fragment or none, and keeps the sha256 of the raw bytes, preview and vector rows it read

for a full_raw source it measures the legacy preview against the raw transcript (capped and diverged entries, missing entry ranges caused by a trimmed head, an incremental offset gap or an uncollected tail) and the vector rows against the raw turns (renumbered rows, orphans, turns without a vector); a preview-only source reports possibly capped and possibly trimmed with missing ranges unknown

hooks.memory.source_audit.SourceAudit.run adds or upgrades only the sources whose class rose, replays unchanged sources, keeps a held class against a lower observation and refuses any change at a stale revision before writing
hooks.memory.source_audit.SourceAudit.certify gives a lossless label only to a full_raw source; report lists each class separately and counts source_fidelity_classes
metrics: source_fidelity_classes counts audited sources per class: full_raw, preview_only, vector_only and missing

outcomes.accepted: classifications held in the audit record at its revision
outcomes.committed: the audit record written to the fixture JSON file and read back
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no legacy Redis, Postgres or raw transcript folder outside the fixture was audited
outcomes.observed: case outputs in the a, b and c result files from the preflight touched tests run 40498681050 at the tested commit

remaining_limitations: The legacy caps and defects are read from the retired service's store, collector, parser and embedding source; a live Redis and Postgres export is not audited here and needs its own read only run.
Raw entries are matched to preview entries by uuid and to vector rows by the legacy chunk text; a preview entry without a uuid cannot be placed in a missing range.
The audit record has no lock; one writer updates it at a time.
rollback_rehearsal: C reverted to the record on disk after an interrupted upgrade, so beta stayed preview_only with its preview hash; rerunning upgraded only beta, a rerun after its raw file disappeared kept beta full_raw with its raw hash, and B showed every refusal left the record byte identical

spec_mapping.authoritative_record: the audit JSON file written by cases A and C is the authoritative classification record in this mocked fixture; raw files, previews and vector rows stay authoritative sources and are never deleted
spec_mapping.authority: SourceAudit is an operator side reader of historical data and takes no grant; it changes no session data and a classification never widens access
spec_mapping.boundary: the audit reads legacy previews and vector rows as data; it does not rebuild the legacy collector, store or service
spec_mapping.owned_paths: hooks/memory/source_audit.py and docs/swarm-v2/source-fidelity.md; the planned hooks/memory/migrations package would shadow the existing hooks.memory.migrations module, so the audit is a sibling module

supported_versions: legacy transcript service store, collector and embeddings at its archived head; session corpus importer of SV2-RET
